correctness.rationale: For H=(x²+y²)/2 the exact smooth-crossing energy relation is dH/dx=xF/(F-σ sqrt(2H-x²)). Large R makes denominators uniformly nonzero on finitely many support intervals; each leg changes energy O(R^-1). Adding upper and lower legs yields 2∫xF Y/(Y²-F²)dx with uniform analytic expansion 2M1/R+2M3/R³+O(R^-4), and division by R gives displacement 2M1/R²+2M3/R⁴+O(R^-5). Piecewise-affine finite flow admits smooth reciprocal-radius dependence and derivatives, permitting ∂_uG=4M3 u+O(u²). Independent exact integration of the two pulse pieces confirms M1=5λ/2 and M3(0)=51/25. Monotonicity of G(u,λ) for u>0 small implies exactly one exterior root for λ<0 and none for λ>=0; solving yields R²~102/[125(-λ)] and P′=1-204/(25R^5)+o(R^-5). A claim only about this exterior section is proved; global cycle counts are not. No complete numerical IVP census was independently rerun.
